entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.3980 Of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/accused under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in Crime No.864 of 2020 pending on the file of Nallapadu Police Station, Guntur Urban, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188,
272, 273, 420 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short "I.P.C.") and Sections 58 & 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh, this criminal petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

_ _ JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Date: 21.09.2020 SP Gosula Kishore vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 21 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169108944/
